title: Beilinson-Soule Vanishing Conjecture for Rational Motivic Cohomology
exact_target: Do all nonpositive-degree rational motivic cohomology groups vanish except for the ordinary degree-zero, weight-zero part?

sources.citation: F. Deglise, "Generic motives and motivic cohomology of fields", arXiv:2408.06233 [math.AG], v1 dated 12 August 2024.
